Table 3 corroborates control men 25 + women 20 = 45 and capability–empathy men 58 + women 52 = 110 (vengefulness continues on p. 507). No outcome-specific attrition is stated. Outcome wording could denote whole TRIM or its Vengefulness subscale; both use these same cells. Target match applies to assigned N only.
